proposed_new_terms.definition: A GrowthBook experiment variant controlling plan file size in plan mode V2, with arms trim/cut/cap representing progressively stricter verbosity reduction
An optional plan-mode phase (gated by tengu_plan_mode_interview_phase or USER_TYPE=ant) where the agent asks clarifying questions before finalizing the plan
A state the model can enter but cannot leave, such as plan mode in channel-based sessions where the approval dialog cannot be displayed
A field in the permission context that stores the user's permission mode before entering plan mode, used to restore it on exit
